special_notes: This is a mobile stool with multiple articulations. It has five caster wheels, each with independent swivel (Z-axis) and roll (local Y-axis) motion. The seat height is adjustable via a prismatic joint along the Z-axis. The seat also swivels freely around the Z-axis.
